description: Timestamp of the inventory log entry (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS); 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31, 30 minutes apart within a day from 08:00
notes: Used for the chronological train/test split. Sort by date before any lag or rolling feature.
Join key for per-SKU history. No product names are held (anonymised).

description: Product category: Grocery, Electronics, Apparel or HomeDecor
notes: Not stable per SKU in the 500 original rows (a known data-quality issue, see docs/cleaning_log.md).

description: Retail season of the log date: Winter (16 Nov-Feb), Summer (Mar-Jun), Monsoon (Jul-Sep), Festive_Diwali (1 Oct-15 Nov)
notes: Known in advance from the calendar, so it is a valid forecasting input. Demand multipliers 1.0 / 1.2 / 0.95 / 1.4 are a planning assumption.

description: Units physically on hand at the log entry; 0 means a stock-out
notes: Must be >= 0. Used for alerts and days of cover, not as a demand input.

description: The store's fixed reorder point; the store flags an item when stock_qty <= reorder_level
notes: Baseline alert rule that the forecast-based rule is compared with.

description: Units sold per day for the SKU on that log date (seasonal multipliers applied)
notes: TARGET of the forecast. Must never be used as an input for the same record (leakage).

description: MASKED supplier unit cost: relative Cost Index (dataset median = 100, +/-2% noise), not a currency amount
notes: SENSITIVE in raw form (supplier pricing). Real prices are not recoverable from this column.
Anonymised identifier; no supplier names or contract terms are held.

description: Supplier lead time between placing and receiving an order
notes: Normal range 3-21; values above 21 mark a supplier delay. Must be >= 1.
